objective: determine how far the already-completed metadata-only global capacity census can support a fewer-species-higher-photo-count sharedness design, without opening image pixels, flower colour, or ecological outcomes
fixed_right_censor_definition: raw_results == 200 because the parent metadata request returned at most 200 observations per species
required_outputs: species count with after_observer_cap at or above each frozen threshold
species count with raw_results equal to 200
among raw_results-equal-200 species, counts above each frozen after_observer_cap threshold
explicit statement that availability above 200 raw results is not identifiable from the parent census

prospective_extension_if_needed.scope: only species right-censored at raw_results=200 in the parent census
prospective_extension_if_needed.rule: freeze query depth, observer cap, prior-experiment exclusions, request-error ceiling, and deterministic species ordering before issuing any new metadata request
